commands.name: TS.ADD
commands.rationale: The typed tool preserves exact millisecond timestamps and finite double values, and exposes on-demand creation options explicitly.

commands.name: TS.ALTER
commands.rationale: Retention shrinks trim stored samples and the label set is replaced rather than merged, so alteration is full-access.

commands.name: TS.CREATE
commands.rationale: The typed tool exposes retention, encoding, chunk, duplicate-policy, label, and ignore configuration with bounded label counts.

commands.name: TS.CREATERULE
commands.rationale: The typed tool validates aggregator versions and requires same-slot source and destination series on Redis Cluster.

commands.name: TS.DECRBY
commands.rationale: Counter adjustment is an ordinary bounded write with explicit on-demand creation options.

commands.name: TS.DEL
commands.rationale: Range deletion permanently removes samples and therefore requires full access and an explicit inclusive range.

commands.name: TS.DELETERULE
commands.rationale: Removing a compaction rule discards a configured downsampling pipeline and is classified as destructive.

commands.name: TS.GET
commands.rationale: The typed tool distinguishes an empty series from a missing sample and normalizes RESP2 and RESP3 shapes.

commands.name: TS.INCRBY
commands.rationale: Counter adjustment is an ordinary bounded write with explicit on-demand creation options.

commands.name: TS.INFO
commands.rationale: Series metadata, labels, and compaction rules return as one bounded structured attribute map.

commands.name: TS.MADD
commands.rationale: Bulk appends are bounded per call, keep per-sample failures aligned in-band, and require same-slot keys on Redis Cluster.

commands.name: TS.MGET
commands.rationale: Label-filtered reads only observe one node, so the tool is standalone-only instead of claiming database-wide aggregation on Cluster.

commands.name: TS.MRANGE
commands.rationale: Label-filtered reads only observe one node, so the tool is standalone-only instead of claiming database-wide aggregation on Cluster.

commands.name: TS.MREVRANGE
commands.rationale: Label-filtered reads only observe one node, so the tool is standalone-only instead of claiming database-wide aggregation on Cluster.

commands.name: TS.QUERYINDEX
commands.rationale: Label-filtered key listing only observes one node, so the tool is standalone-only instead of claiming database-wide aggregation on Cluster.

commands.name: TS.RANGE
commands.rationale: Single-series pages are count-bounded with range continuation metadata and share the encoded output budgets.

commands.name: TS.REVRANGE
commands.rationale: Single-series pages are count-bounded with range continuation metadata and share the encoded output budgets.
